seoDescription: Latest news and updates from Sunlord Electronics including new product releases, technical announcements, and company updates.

news.title: Sunlord Expands MLCC Portfolio with High-Voltage Series
news.summary: Sunlord announces new high-voltage MLCC series for automotive and industrial applications.
news.content: Sunlord Electronics has expanded its multilayer ceramic capacitor portfolio with new high-voltage series designed for demanding automotive and industrial applications. The new capacitors feature enhanced voltage ratings up to 1000V and AEC-Q200 qualification.

news.title: Sunlord Achieves AEC-Q200 Certification for Power Inductor Series
news.summary: SWPA and SPH series power inductors now fully qualified for automotive applications.
news.content: Sunlord Electronics is pleased to announce that its popular SWPA and SPH series power inductors have full AEC-Q200 certification. This qualification enables automotive designers to use these components with confidence in critical vehicle applications.

news.title: Sunlord Introduces New Chip Bead Series for 5G Applications
news.summary: High-frequency chip beads optimized for 5G and high-speed data applications.
news.content: Sunlord has launched a new series of high-frequency chip beads specifically designed for 5G and high-speed data applications. The new series offers excellent EMI suppression up to 6GHz, making them ideal for 5G base stations and mobile devices.

news.title: Sunlord Expands Production Capacity to Meet Growing Demand
news.summary: New manufacturing facility increases capacity for power inductors and capacitors.
news.content: Sunlord Electronics has completed the expansion of its manufacturing facility in Shenzhen, China. The expansion adds significant capacity for power inductors and multilayer ceramic capacitors to meet growing global demand.

news.title: Sunlord Releases Compact Common Mode Chokes for USB4
news.summary: New SCM series common mode chokes support USB4 and Thunderbolt 4 interfaces.
news.content: Sunlord has introduced new compact common mode chokes specifically designed for USB4 and Thunderbolt 4 applications. The new components provide excellent common mode noise suppression while maintaining signal integrity at data rates up to 40Gbps.
